definitions.full: H4364. makmar מִכְמָר noun [masculine] net, snare , bringing an animal to its fall, מ ׳כְּתוֺא Isa 51:20 like an antelope of ( in ) a net or snare (compare II. חֵרֶם , II. רֶשֶׁת ). [ מַכְמֹר ] noun [masculine] net, snare (see foregoing) — plural suffix רְשָׁעִים בְּמַכְמֹרָיו יִמְּלוּ Psa 141:10 ; so Gr Che 140:11 ( במכמרות for בְּמַהֲמֹרוֺת ᵑ0 , see).
